items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Chester John Hamilton, Chester John and Brett Boboots... [INTERVIEWEE] work out at. Wesley Battle, Coco, Homer Williams.

ctx.x: I'm sure, Professor Fighters used to, used to like, I'm going to get my eyes, Chester John Hamilton, Chester John and Brett Boboots, and all that, that's where they used to
